findings.title: Mandatory Anthropic image critic sends a schema the provider rejects
findings.change: Use a shared provider wire-schema transformer for image and text structured outputs, retaining strict local response validation.

findings.title: Generation timeout spends the protected time for mandatory reviews
findings.change: Reserve time for outstanding required critics and persistence before authorizing generation or another critic. Admission includes the actual request allowance.

findings.title: Raster dimension validation can permanently break visual history
findings.change: Reject new images with either axis over 8192 before commit. Keep previously saved wide images readable under the pixel-area bound, with an actionable preflight blocker.

findings.title: Reloaded uncommitted private commands have no recovery path
findings.change: Add an owner-serialized durable abandonment endpoint and browser recovery action. A missing command is fenced against late arrival; an already committed command returns its original outcome.

findings.title: Definitive4xx on retry never releases pending command
findings.change: Retire retained receipts after explicitly annotated not-committed 4xx rejections, while preserving unknown outcomes and UUID conflicts.

findings.title: Research reserve rejection stalls proposals until the active-time cutoff
findings.change: Use the frozen finish reserve for research allowance. Settle pending research as unavailable when no research time remains so proposals can proceed.

findings.title: Preflight accepts selected files that cannot fit the evidence packet
findings.change: Share exact evidence-packet planning between preflight, Start and runtime. Reject passage overflow and oversized structured sources before intake, including selected parent evidence.

findings.title: Accepted JPEGs can normalize into permanently unreviewable images
findings.change: Separate the original 10 MiB upload limit from canonical 64 MiB PNG validation. Review still enforces the actual configured outgoing provider limit.

findings.title: Image and vision requests can run beyond their total deadlines
findings.change: Use the absolute-deadline HTTP transport for image and vision requests, including headers and bounded error-body parsing.

findings.title: Expired visual sessions retain finish holds and unserviceable queued work
findings.change: Expire visual sessions at the paid deadline or queued consent expiry. Quarantine unserviceable funding configurations, fence queued publication and release only unused review funds.

findings.title: Currency rounding can falsely mark an over-budget option affordable
findings.change: Calculate and format totals using a pinned ISO 4217 minor-unit table. Reject unsupported currency codes in preflight; preserve three-decimal amounts in the UI.

findings.title: Saved nonUSD amounts are presented as USD during editing
findings.change: Label budget and component inputs with their saved currencies and inherit the brief currency for new candidates.

findings.title: Switching drafts retains stale public-term browser validation error
findings.change: Recompute public-research field validity when the selected draft changes.

findings.title: Native diagrams ignore frozen output dimensions
findings.change: Validate native diagram dimensions against the frozen brief before reservation/rendering; derive the browser starter from those dimensions.

findings.title: Diagram edge labels can be clipped despite successful required-text validation
findings.change: Validate edge-label ink bounds before rendering. Embed the exact trusted packaged font and fix SVG text-run lengths to the validated advances, including whitespace. Preserve the attachment sandbox and remote-resource restrictions while permitting its fixed embedded font. Retain historical version1/2 read behavior.

findings.title: Every maintenance cycle re-purges the complete permanent deletion history
findings.change: Process at most 100 new manifest entries per routine cycle using a transactionally committed identity/offset/anchor cursor. Skip already completed fences; keep full manifest replay for explicit restore/operations.

findings.title: The expiry regression uses UTC yesterday against a Phoenix comparison date
findings.change: Construct the expiry test date in the brief timezone using ZoneInfo, matching production comparison semantics.

findings.title: Waiting runs multiply scheduler records and saturate dispatch
findings.change: Keep one active advance intention under existing run locks without locking/mutating publisher-held outbox rows. Reconciliation retires legacy duplicates.

findings.title: Concurrent deletion can fail a normal backup and close all writes and dispatch
findings.change: Coordinate backup database snapshots/file copies with deletion using a cross-process artifact guard. Deletion retains the guard through transaction commit; backup releases it before recording database status.

findings.title: An older autosave can overwrite the newly opened linked follow-up brief
findings.change: Fence autosave completions by editor generation and mode so switching into follow-up or clarification cannot be overwritten by an older save.

findings.title: Editing any requirements line erases existing typed constraints
findings.change: Keep typed constraints and their stable IDs outside the manual requirements textarea; show them as saved numeric checks.

findings.title: Entering a price can leave it excluded from every cost calculation
findings.change: Expose cost inclusion status. Disable amount entry for excluded/not-applicable costs until the user explicitly includes them.

findings.title: Review-history navigation reuses another run's unsaved choice and notes
findings.change: Reset unsaved choice/reason/outcome fields when changing report history, and require the selected option to belong to the current comparison.

findings.title: Saving a native interface clears its browser actions and assertions
findings.change: Persist the exact private native-interface interaction plan in version provenance, restore it on reopen, and retain it across candidate renders.

findings.title: Expired terminal retries retain unused finish funds and block new runs
findings.change: Reconcile held finish funds on terminal runs after frozen authorization expires. Allow explicit terminal retry abandonment, retaining unknown attempt exposure and saved history.

findings.title: Anonymous sign-in blocks the ASGI event loop during database contention
findings.change: Offload complete hosted login reservation, login-state save and callback-session transactions to the threadpool, preserving database locking and identity fencing.

findings.title: Markdown export turns untrusted evidence into active image/HTML markup
findings.change: Escape all interpolated report/evidence strings as inert Markdown literals and HTML text. Keep raw JSON exports unchanged.
